{"CommandLine":"cd /home/user/lean_project && lake env lean --stdin << 'EOF'
import Mathlib

def replaceChar (s : String) (target : Char) (replacement : String) : String :=
  String.mk (s.data.flatMap (fun c => if c == target then replacement.data else [c]))

def escape (s : String) (quote : Bool := true) : String :=
  let s := replaceChar s '&' "&"
  let s := replaceChar s '<' "<"
  let s := replaceChar s '>' ">"
  if quote then
    let s := replaceChar s '"' """
    replaceChar s '\'' "'"
  else
    s

def escapeChar (c : Char) (quote : Bool := true) : List Char :=
  if c == '&' then "&".data
  else if c == '<' then "<".data
  else if c == '>' then ">".data
  else if quote && c == '"' then """.data
  else if quote && c == '\'' then "'".data
  else [c]

def isSpecialChar (c : Char) (quote : Bool := true) : Bool :=
  c == '&' || c == '<' || c == '>' || (quote && (c == '"' || c == '\''))

theorem single_pass_thm (s : String) (quote : Bool) :
    (escape s quote).data = s.data.flatMap (fun c => escapeChar c quote) := by
  cases quote
  · simp only [escape, replaceChar, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.flatMap_assoc]
    congr 1; funext c
    by_cases h1 : c = '&' <;> simp [h1, escapeChar]
    by_cases h2 : c = '<' <;> simp [h2]
  · simp only [escape, replaceChar, ↓reduceIte, List.flatMap_assoc]
    congr 1; funext c
    by_cases h1 : c = '&' <;> simp [h1, escapeChar]
    by_cases h2 : c = '<' <;> simp [h2]
    by_cases h3 : c = '>' <;> simp [h3]
    by_cases h4 : c = '"' <;> simp [h4]

theorem quotes_preserved_when_quote_false_thm (s : String) :
    (escape s false).data.count '"' = s.data.count '"' ∧
    (escape s false).data.count '\'' = s.data.count '\'' := by
  rw [single_pass_thm]
  induction s.data with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.count_append, List.count_cons, ih.1, ih.2]
    unfold escapeChar
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega

theorem exact_length_thm (s : String) (quote : Bool) :
    (escape s quote).length =
      s.length + 4 * s.data.count '&' + 3 * s.data.count '<' + 3 * s.data.count '>' +
        (if quote then 5 * s.data.count '"' + 5 * s.data.count '\'' else 0) := by
  simp only [String.length, single_pass_thm]
  induction s.data with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.count_cons, ih]
    cases quote <;>
    · unfold escapeChar
      split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega

theorem length_bounds_thm (s : String) (quote : Bool) :
    s.length ≤ (escape s quote).length ∧
    (escape s quote).length ≤ (if quote then 6 else 5) * s.length := by
  simp only [String.length, single_pass_thm]
  induction s.data with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append, List.length_cons]
    cases quote <;>
    · unfold escapeChar
      split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega

theorem ampersand_count_thm (s : String) (quote : Bool) :
    (escape s quote).data.count '&' =
      s.data.count '&' + s.data.count '<' + s.data.count '>' +
        (if quote then s.data.count '"' + s.data.count '\'' else 0) := by
  rw [single_pass_thm]
  induction s.data with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.count_append, List.count_cons, ih]
    cases quote <;>
    · unfold escapeChar
      split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega

theorem semicolon_count_thm (s : String) (quote : Bool) :
    (escape s quote).data.count ';' =
      s.data.count ';' + s.data.count '&' + s.data.count '<' + s.data.count '>' +
        (if quote then s.data.count '"' + s.data.count '\'' else 0) := by
  rw [single_pass_thm]
  induction s.data with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c cs ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.count_append, List.count_cons, ih]
    cases quote <;>
    · unfold escapeChar
      split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega
EOF
